text:
maya: Quick design review — I pushed a WIP with a tiny minimap for the stacktrace pane (top-right corner of the panel). It's basically a zoomed-out thumbnail that shows all frames and the current viewport. Click to jump + drag to scrub. Also added an Export action in the kebab menu for now. thoughts on placement, copy, and accessibility?

trevor: Love the minimap idea for long traces, especially for test/infra traces. Two quick questions: 1) should clicking jump be instant or confirm (risk of losing current context)? 2) where does the minimap live on narrow screens?

maya: clicking jumps immediately (we thought users want quick nav) but we can add an undo toast with "Back to previous view". For narrow screens it collapses to a single-line scrubber and toggles expand on tap.

cheng: a11y: need to make the minimap keyboard-focusable and expose the current viewport region. Suggest role="application"? maybe simpler: provide dedicated controls: "Zoom out" "Jump to start" "Jump to error frame" with proper aria-labels. Also color contrast for the highlighted viewport is borderline.

olivia: Copy/label debate: in the export menu we currently have: "Export trace JSON" and "Copy permalink". Product suggestion: change to "Download trace JSON" and "Copy trace link" — clearer verbs. Any objections?

samir: prefer "Download trace JSON" — "Export" is ambiguous for some users. Also, if someone expects a HAR vs JSON, we should be explicit (e.g., "Download JSON (trace)").

maya: good point. let's use "Download trace JSON" and later add another menu item if we support HAR or zipped assets.

trevor: keyboard shortcuts: can we add a global focusable element with `aria-pressed` states? or at least a keyboard shortcut to open the kebab menu when the trace panel is focused — e.g., press `.` to show actions. Need to coordinate with os-level shortcuts.

cheng: for screen-reader flow: when a user activates "Download trace JSON" aria-live should announce "Trace download started" and then "Download complete" if we kick off a client-side blob. For copying link, do `aria-live="polite"` and call out the link copied to clipboard.

maya: example snippet I mocked for copy button: 
```js
async function copyTraceLink(url) {
  await navigator.clipboard.writeText(url);
  announce("Trace link copied to clipboard"); // aria-live region
}
```

olivia: tiny copy tweak: instead of "Trace link copied to clipboard" use "Trace link copied" — shorter and reads better in the toast. Use the longer version for SR only (aria-label on the toast).

a11ybot: automated check: the minimap thumb color #b3d4ff has contrast ratio 2.7:1 against background #ffffff. Minimum for UI components is 3:1 — please update. Recommendation: use #7fbfff or add a 1px solid outline with accessible color.

cheng: noted. I'll update the spec: add 2px focus ring (brand-blue at 4.5:1) and adjust fill to #7fbfff per a11ybot.

samir: telemetry: please instrument events: `minimap_open`, `minimap_jump`, `download_trace_clicked`, `copy_trace_link`. Include context: trace_id, frame_index, origin (panel vs timeline).

maya: UX question: do we surface correlation IDs in the export JSON differently? currently they are nested under `meta.correlation_id`. Product thought: surface `correlation_id` at the top-level of the exported object for easier ingestion. Opinions?

trevor: yes prefer top-level `correlation_id` for downstream tooling. Backwards compatibility concern: include both? maybe `correlation_id` top-level and retain `meta.correlation_id`.

olivia: action: i'll update copy strings and the kebab menu ordering: 1) Download trace JSON 2) Copy trace link 3) Open in timeline 4) More... (for future).

maya: dev action: trevor/cheng/samir to prototype keyboard nav, a11y fixes, and telemetry. olivia i'll upload new copy to Figma by EOD. I'll add an undo toast for the jump and wire the aria-live messages.

trevor: small nit: minimize animation when jumping — keep it under 160ms to avoid disorienting users.

cheng: +1 on animation timing, and ensure reduced-motion respects prefers-reduced-motion.

olivia: copy decisions: toast text: "View updated — press ⌘Z to undo"? maybe avoid implying global undo. Use "View updated — click Undo" with explicit button.

maya: agreed. We'll include a small inline "Undo" button in the toast.

olivia: I'll send the updated copy file here. :thumbsup:

maya: thanks all — seems we have consensus on placement (top-right minimap), copy (Download trace JSON / Copy trace link), a11y fixes (contrast + keyboard + aria-live), and telemetry events. I'll follow up with a short PR and link to the Figma frames.

samir: leaving a note to add an analytics flag so we can A/B the minimap later.

olivia: uploaded Figma -> https://www.figma.com/file/abcd1234/trace-minimap-proto

maya: linking the prototype here too: https://redwood-internal/prototypes/trace-minimap — will include keyboard walkthrough.

cheng: I'll run the updated color + focus tests tomorrow and report back.

olivia: thanks everyone!

maya: closing the loop: action items: [olivia: copy + figma], [cheng: a11y + focus], [trevor: keyboard + prototyping], [samir: telemetry], [maya: PR + undo toast].
